changed.item: The original asks whether they could help ('Could we help Fairview Markets cover...?'). The edit states a desire instead ('We'd like to help...'). This shifts from asking about fit to asserting intent, which is slightly more presumptive.

'99.2% on-time rate' is now '99.2% of our deliveries arrived on time'. This specifies that the metric covers deliveries arriving, while the original rate was unspecified (it could have included pickups). The scope is narrowed only slightly.
